// diagnostic

L0533

This tail call can't reuse the frame because `{name}` closes after it returns

What

This tail call can't reuse the frame because `{name}` closes after it returns

Why

`{name}` is still open at the call, and its Close cleanup runs when its scope ends, after the call returns; the call keeps its frame, so a chain of such calls grows the stack

Fix

Close `{name}` before the call with `close(^{name})`, or open it in a smaller block that ends before the call

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0533: tests/ui_lint/tail_call_blocked.warn.

Warning [jet.TailCallBlocked]: This tail call can't reuse the frame because `r` closes after it returns
  --> tests/ui_lint/tail_call_blocked.jet:18:5
    |
 18 |     count(n - 1, acc + r.name.len())
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: `r` is a `Res` that is still open here, and its Close implementation runs when its scope ends, after this call returns; the call keeps its frame, so a chain of such calls grows the stack
 Fix: Close `r` before the call with `close(^r)` (bind any argument that reads it first), or open it in a smaller block that ends before the call
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0533

Warning [jet.RedundantFinalReturn]: An explicit `return` is used on the final value line
  --> tests/ui_lint/tail_call_blocked.jet:25:5
    |
 25 |     return deferred(n - 1)
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: An unadorned expression on the final value line is Jet's implicit return; `return` is for early exits
 Fix: Remove the final `return` and leave the expression as the block tail
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0530
